models.name: combined_events
models.sql: SELECT event_id, user_id, event_time, event_type FROM smelt.ref('raw_events')

models.name: active_users
models.sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as activity_count FROM smelt.ref('user_sessions') WHERE session_count > 0 GROUP BY user_id

models.name: inactive_users
models.sql: SELECT user_id FROM smelt.ref('user_stats') WHERE total_sessions = 0
